lead_headline: Vaultaire HiFi bar debuts beneath La Forêt as restaurant leads surge to 73 (5 new today) while subscription net holds +1 despite March's quietest Saturday

restaurant.blurb: 5 new leads today push active inventory to 73 (35 openings, 38 closures)—highest tally since tracker launch. Sunday additions: Laredo Taco Company debuts inside new 7-Eleven at 5991 W Colfax (Tex-Mex chain's gas station model), Taco John's/Steak Escape combo at 5810 Logan flags August 2024 closure (now Taqueria Los Gallitos occupies space), New Dragon Berkeley Chinese spot marks 13-year run ended late February. Week's 73-lead spread: openings cluster Union Station corridor (Mendocino Farms third Denver outpost, C Burger regenerative beef at McGregor Square, Ogo Korean BBQ counter-service debut) while closures concentrate Cherry Creek/Capitol Hill (California Pizza Kitchen 25-year tenant, Your Mom's House tax seizure, Colfax and Cream 2-month collapse). Temporal density sharpens: 38 of 73 leads detected in past 10 days as March scraping velocity doubles February's weekly average.

foreclosure.blurb: 34 filings this week trail prior week's 42 by 19%—March's softest 7-day count outside holiday-shortened windows, with top case capping at $686K Arapahoe property (24296 E Ohio) vs zero $2M+ outliers for first time in five weeks.

liquor.blurb: Zero applications today stretch March's statewide filing drought to 29 consecutive days—now 141% beyond any prior gap in 12,316-case archive. Monday's April 1 quarterly deadline looms as database litmus test: silence past Tuesday confirms systemic lag vs demand collapse across metro's hospitality sector.

reputation.blurb: 55 mentions this week climb 15% from prior period's 48—third straight weekly gain as social platforms claim 44% share (Instagram 12, x.com 5, Facebook 6). Denver Post matches Instagram at 12 citations (22% share, down from historical 30%+ dominance), marking source diversification inflection. Top stories: Denver Summit NWSL inaugural 63K-attendance sellout (6 Instagram pickups), Newmark/CBRE commercial real estate hires, coworking expansion coverage in San Antonio Express-News. Four-week total hits 187 mentions across 31 sources—run rate projects 561 annual citations if pace sustains through Q2.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +1 yesterday (1 new, 0 canceled)—March's slowest Saturday since tracker launch—lifts MTD to +56 (+2.0/day), 90-day net to +125. Past 7 days deliver +22 (29 new, 7 canceled) vs prior week's +17, sustaining 4.1 new/day acquisition while churn stabilizes at 1.0/day. Two-week snapshot: March 15-28 averages 4.2 new subscribers daily (59 total) against 13 cancellations—holding 68% above YTD baseline of 2.5 net/day despite mid-month March 18-20 retention dip (6 cancellations across 3 days). Final three March days need +2 net to hit +58 monthly total, tracking 32% ahead of February's pace.
